review_cost.rationale: Approve-with-nits: every issue is small, local and non-blocking; no structural rework needed.

findings.issue: Debounce timer is never cleared when the component unmounts; a pending setTimeout calls goto() with stale props after navigation has started, which can hijack a card/link click made within the 200 ms window.
findings.suggestion: Clear the timer in an $effect cleanup (or onDestroy) so the pending update is dropped when the page unmounts.

findings.issue: getTeamPage re-implements the 'default variety → default Pokémon → slot-sorted types' logic that already exists in getPokemonPage (:288-289), creating a second copy the feature added next to the original.
findings.suggestion: Extract a shared getDefaultPokemon(species): Promise<ApiPokemon> helper in pokedex.ts and use it from both loaders.

findings.issue: Uses setContext/getContext with a Symbol key; with the pinned Svelte ^5.57, the docs now recommend createContext for type-safe context.
findings.suggestion: Replace with `export const [getTeamContext, setTeamContext] = createContext<TeamState>()`, whose get() throws if unset.

findings.issue: A team member whose species no longer resolves is silently filtered out, so the rendered '<n> of 6' can disagree with the cookie's stored count.
findings.suggestion: Either keep a placeholder row for missing members or tolerate the divergence with a comment stating it's intentional.

findings.issue: getTeamPage fetches all 18 full type records even when the team is empty and the coverage table won't be rendered.
findings.suggestion: Early-return `{ members: [], coverage: [] }` when names is empty (the 18 records are cached, so this is only a cold-start cost).

findings.issue: Team cookie is written client-side with no cross-tab reconciliation; a second tab's stale TeamState overwrites the first tab's additions (last-writer-wins).
findings.suggestion: Acceptable for this spec (team 'belongs to the browser'); if it matters later, listen for cookie/storage changes or re-seed from layout data after navigation.

findings.issue: `<meta name="text-scale" content="scale">` is a non-standard meta tag.
findings.suggestion: Remove it or replace with standard text-size-adjust CSS (already present in app.css:13-16).

summary: This is a genuinely current, idiomatic SvelteKit 3 app: config in vite.config.ts, #lib imports, runes everywhere, $app/state, and a clean server-only data layer with an exemplary bounded, promise-deduped cache. Correctness care is high — race-aware search input, server-side page clamping, missing-values-last sorting — with only small gaps: an uncleaned debounce timer, a duplicated default-variety helper the feature introduced, and the older setContext/getContext API instead of createContext. I'd merge it with a nits-only follow-up round.
